integrity: The transform uses unnormalized Lebesgue measure with negative-frequency exponential. Analytic proof and a standalone exact/numerical checker are supplied; computations are not used to infer the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Local real-zero topology only at reciprocal nodes with four distinct integer phases; not a classification of all Fourier zeros, repeated-phase nodes, or higher-dimensional simplex singularities. Independent review and priority certification are absent.
title: Transverse double crossings of tetrahedral Fourier zeros at complete reciprocal nodes
